host_galaxy.comment:
Fong+2022: Fong+2022 Table 2 Gold host association; Silver, Bronze, and Inconclusive associations were not imported. Host J2000 coordinates are from Table 2; Table A1 supplies the photometry. All magnitudes are AB and explicitly uncorrected for Galactic extinction in the burst direction. Table 2 asymmetric redshift uncertainty: -0.17/+0.32; AJST redshift_err is null because it cannot represent asymmetric errors. The table does not unambiguously identify the redshift method; redshift_type is null unless explicitly marked D. Host upper limits have no single uniformly stated confidence level; no 3-sigma label was invented.
Merged-field decision: host coordinates taken from Fong+2022 according to the direct-measurement priority rule.
Merged-field decision: redshift, error, and type taken as one tuple from Fong+2022 according to the recency/method priority rule.
